why: Agent chat messages need a message-specific AI icon, not a generic robot.
This should favor intelligence or reasoning, not a generic settings or hardware symbol.
The icon should describe a linked automation flow.
The result should reflect source inspection rather than a generic search icon.
Trust plus protection should resolve to a security verification icon.
The icon should communicate prohibition, not generic failure.
This is a destructive remove action, not a close or hide action.
Reloading current content is different from retrying after failure.
This should show a setting in the on state.
The icon should mean navigation menu or drawer, not a content list.
The icon should describe back navigation rather than reply or undo.
The user needs refinement controls, not analytics funnel visuals.
